Ishqnama Box Office Collection Day 3: With 40% Jump, Shehnaaz Gill Starrer Records 3rd Highest Opening Weekend In Punjabi In 2026!

Shehnaaz Gill's Ishqnama surpassed Bambukat 2 in its opening weekend at the Indian box office. Check out the day 3 collection!

By
Jishika Madaan
- July 27, 2026 | 2:26 PM IST
  • Join Us
  • Share
    FacebookTwitterWhatsAppEmailCopy
    Copied

Arvindr Khaira’s Punjabi romantic period drama Ishqnama has packed a fair opening weekend. Shehnaaz Gill and Jayy Randhawa starrer surpassed Bambukat 2 to score the 3rd highest opening weekend of 2026 in Punjabi cinema. Scroll below for the day 3 update!

How much did Ishqnama earn in its first weekend?

According to the latest update, Ishqnama collected 1.4 crore net on day 3 of its box office run in India. It witnessed a 40% jump after earning 1 crore on Saturday. The word-of-mouth is excellent, which kept the footfalls coming throughout the first weekend. With little competition from Carry On Jatta 4, all eyes are now on the Monday test.

The total collection in India stands at 3.20 crore net after the opening weekend. While there’s no official confirmation, Ishqnama is reportedly made on a budget of over 20 crore. It must maintain strong momentum hereon to reach breakeven and enter the safe zone. Including taxes, the gross earnings have reached 3.77 crore.

Check out the day-wise box office breakdown in India (net collection):

  • Day 1: 80 lakh
  • Day 2: 1 crore
  • Day 3: 1.4 crore

Total: 3.20 crore

3rd biggest opening weekend of 2026 in Punjabi cinema!

Shehnaaz Gill and Jayy Randhawa’s film recorded the 3rd biggest opening weekend of Punjabi cinema in 2026. It stayed only behind Carry On Jatta 4 and Rabb Da Radio 3. Ishqan Da Lekhe (1.60 crore) is now out of the top 5.

Check out the top 5 opening weekend collections of 2026 in Punjabi cinema (net earnings):

  1. Carry On Jatta 4: 7.80 crore
  2. Rabb Da Radio 3: 3.60 crore
  3. Ishqnama: 3.20 crore
  4. Bambukat 2: 2.10 crore
  5. Viyaah Kartaare Da: 1.80 crore

Ishqnama Box Office Day 3 Summary

  • India net: 3.20 crore
  • India gross: 3.77 crore
